pr_title: schemachanger: add ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... SET DEFAULT
pr_body:
This PR implements `ALTER COLUMN SET DEFAULT` in the declarative
schema changer.

Epic: CRDB-31283

Fixes: #116247
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/116697)

> update: as of v23.2, alter table b alter column x set default 'hi'; is unimplemented in the declarative schema changer (DSC) and will still leave dangling back-reference in the type descriptor. But, starting from v22.1, we supported DROP TYPE in declarative schema changer, and drop type a; , under declarative schema changer, will be able to proceed to drop this type despite it having an dangling back-reference to a table that's already dropped. The legacy schema changer, on the other hand, is not "smart" enough to recognize that and will block the dropping.

tried testing this - confirming we are able to successfully drop the type:


```
demo@127.0.0.1:26257/demoapp/movr> create type a as enum ('hi');                                                                                                            
CREATE TYPE

Time: 4ms total (execution 4ms / network 1ms)

demo@127.0.0.1:26257/demoapp/movr> create table t (x text default 'hi'::a::text);                                                                                           
CREATE TABLE

demo@127.0.0.1:26257/demoapp/movr> alter table t alter column x set default 'hi';                                                                                           
ALTER TABLE

Time: 31ms total (execution 31ms / network 0ms)

demo@127.0.0.1:26257/demoapp/movr> drop type a;                                                                                                                             
DROP TYPE

Time: 45ms total (execution 45ms / network 0ms)

demo@127.0.0.1:26257/demoapp/movr> show create table t;                            
  table_name |                      create_statement
-------------+--------------------------------------------------------------
  t          | CREATE TABLE public.t (
             |     x STRING NULL DEFAULT 'hi':::STRING,
             |     rowid INT8 NOT VISIBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT unique_rowid(),
             |     CONSTRAINT t_pkey PRIMARY KEY (rowid ASC)
             | )
(1 row)
```

issue_context.title: Support `ALTER COLUMN SET DEFAULT` in declarative schema changer
issue_context.body:
Let's implement `ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN .. SET DEFAULT ...` in declarative schema changer. Similarly to the instructions given in #115374, we can start by implementing the logic in the builder layer.

Epic: CRDB-31283

Jira issue: CRDB-34538
comments: let's ensure we correctly implement it such that it avoids dangling back-references in the type (if this table's default expression references a type descriptor) as in https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/91972
